d:
The road to the championship gets tougher as Guy Fieri brings the remaining contenders into the semi-finals at Flavortown Market. With strict budget caps, challenging aisle restrictions and high-end protein assignments, the chefs must make smart choices and deliver impressive dishes under intense time pressure. Only two competitors can secure a place in the tournament championship, so every decision counts.
Watch Guy's Grocery Games Season 37 Episode 4 only on discovery+ India.
